005/**
006 * <p>
007 * Main application class and execution entry point for DayPlanner.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Loads the configured activity files, runs the interactive menu, and saves
011 * changes when the user quits.
012 * </p>
013 */
014public class DayPlanner {
015    private static final Input KEYBOARD = new Input();
016
017    private static final String DATA_DIRECTORY = "dat";
018    private static String dataFileName;
019    private static ActivityList activities;
020
021
022    /**
023     * Main entry point for the DayPlanner application.
024     * 
025     * @param args command-line arguments (currently unused).
026     */
027    public static void main(String[] args) {
028        // Get the data file name from args
029        if (args.length != 1) {
030            System.out.println("\nThe program has halted because you did not specify a data file name.");
031            System.out.println("A sample file named 'sampleData.ras' is included. Specify it as the first execution argument:");
032            System.out.println("\tjava -jar bin/DayPlanner.jar sampleData.ras\n");
033            return;
034        }
035        dataFileName = args[0];
036
037        // Initialize activitylist
038        try {
039            activities = new ActivityList(DATA_DIRECTORY, dataFileName);
040        } catch (Exception e) {
041            System.out.println("\nError initializing activitylist from this data file ("+dataFileName+").\n");
042            return;
043        }
044
045        // Now the the ActivityList is initialized we can Show the GUI
046        new GUIDayPlanner(activities);
047
048        /*
049        // This is Legacy Code that executes the old, terminal-based command loop.
050        // Perform the command loop until the user quits
051        boolean doLoop = true;
052        while (doLoop)
053            doLoop = commandLoop();
054
055        // The above loop only finishes when the user wants to quit
056        quit(true);
057        */
058    }
059
060
061    /**
062     * Saves the list and exits the program.
063     * 
064     * @param print Whether to print output.
065     * @return True if there was a RAS save failure, false otherwise.
066     */
067    public static boolean quit(boolean print) {
068        // Attempt to save the list in RAS format
069        boolean errors = saveToRAS();
070
071        if (print) {
072            if (errors)    System.out.println("\nError saving the list.");
073            else           System.out.println("\nThe list was saved successfully.");
074            System.out.println("\nNow quitting DayPlanner. Goodbye!");
075        }
076
077        return errors;
078    }
079
080
081
082    /**
083     * Displays the main menu and processes a single user command.
084     * 
085     * @return {@code true} to show the menu again, or {@code false} after
086     *         processing quit.
087     */
088    public static boolean commandLoop() {
089        // Print a big greeting message
090        System.out.println("\n\n\t\t===-=-==-=====-==-=-===\n\n");
091        System.out.println("\t『 DAY PLANNER 』  Main Menu\n");
092        System.out.println(DayPlannerUtils.getGreeting(activities.size()));
093        System.out.println("\nPlease enter a command:");
094        System.out.println("\t1. add    - Insert a new activity");
095        System.out.println("\t2. search - Search for an activity");
096        System.out.println("\t3. quit   - Exit DayPlanner\n");
097
098        String cmd;
099        MenuOption option;
100        while (true) {
101            cmd = KEYBOARD.readCommand();
102            option = MenuOption.parse(cmd);
103
104            if (option == null) {
105                System.out.println("Invalid command: \"" + cmd + "\".");
106                System.out.println("Please enter 'add' (or 'a'), 'search' (or 's'), or 'quit' (or 'q'):");
107                continue;
108            } else {
109                break;
110            }
111        }
112
113        switch (option) {
114            case ADD    -> addActivity();
115            case SEARCH -> searchForActivity();
116            case QUIT   -> { return false; }
117        }
118
119        return true;
120    }
121
122

124    /**
125     * Saves the activity list to its RAS file.
126     * 
127     * @return {@code true} if the list could not be saved; {@code false}
128     *         if the list was written successfully.
129     */
130    public static boolean saveToRAS() {
131        return !activities.saveToRAS(DATA_DIRECTORY, dataFileName);
132    }

136    /**
137     * Prompts the user for details and adds a new activity to the appropriate list.
138     */
139    public static void addActivity() {
140        System.out.println("Let's add a new activity to the DayPlanner.");
141
142        // 1. Activity type
143        ActivityType type;
144
145        while (true) {
146            System.out.println("Enter the type of this activity.");
147            System.out.println("For Home, type 'home' or 1. For School, type 'school' or 2. For Other, type 'other' or 3:");
148            type = ActivityType.parse(KEYBOARD.readString());
149
150            if (type == null) {
151                System.out.println("Invalid activity type. Try again:");
152                continue;
153            }
154
155            break;
156        }
157
158        // 2. Title
159        String title;
160        while (true) {
161            System.out.println("Enter a title.");
162            title = KEYBOARD.readString();
163            if (!title.isEmpty())
164                break;
165            System.out.println("Title cannot be empty. Try again:");
166        }
167
168        // 3. Start time
169        System.out.println("Enter a starting time.");
170        Time startTime = KEYBOARD.readTime();
171
172        // 4. End time
173        Time endTime;
174        while (true) {
175            System.out.println("Enter an ending time.");
176            endTime = KEYBOARD.readTime();
177
178            if (startTime.compareTo(endTime) < 0)
179                break;
180
181            System.out.println("Ending time has to be after the starting time (" + startTime + "). Try again:");
182        }
183
184        // 5. Optional comment
185        System.out.println("Would you like to enter a comment?");
186        String comment = null;
187        if (KEYBOARD.readBool()) {
188            System.out.println("Enter a comment.");
189            comment = KEYBOARD.readString();
190            if (comment.isEmpty())
191                comment = null;
192        }
193
194        // 6. Location (Other activities only)
195        String location = null;
196        if (type == ActivityType.OTHER) {
197            while (true) {
198                System.out.println("Enter a location.");
199                location = KEYBOARD.readString();
200                if (!location.isEmpty())
201                    break;
202                System.out.println("Location cannot be empty for Other activities. Try again:");
203            }
204        }
205
206        // 7. Instantiate and insert activity
207        Activity act = switch (type) {
208            case HOME   -> new HomeActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
209            case SCHOOL -> new SchoolActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
210            case OTHER  -> new OtherActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment, location);
211            default     -> new Activity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
212        };
213
214        if (act != null) {
215            activities.add(act);
216            System.out.println("Successfully created the new activity:\n\t" + act.toString());
217        }
218    }

222    /**
223     * Asks which activities to look for, then displays every activity that
224     * matches the filters.
225     */
226    public static void searchForActivity() {
227        System.out.println("Let's search for activities in the DayPlanner.");
228
229        // an empty type means the search should include every activity
230        ActivityType type = null;
231        while (true) {
232            System.out.println("Enter activity type ('home', 'school', 'other'), or press Enter to search all types:");
233            String input = KEYBOARD.readString();
234            if (input.isEmpty())
235                break;
236
237            type = ActivityType.parse(input);
238            if (type != null)
239                break;
240
241            System.out.println("Invalid activity type: \"" + input + "\". Please enter 'home', 'school', 'other', or press Enter to skip:");
242        }
243
244        // FILTER BY KEYWORD
245        // if input is blank, do not restrict titles
246        // otherwise, treat each word as its own filter
247        System.out.println("Enter title keywords (separated by spaces), or press Enter to match any title:");
248        String keywordInput = KEYBOARD.readString();
249        String[] keywords = keywordInput.isEmpty()
250            ? null
251            : keywordInput.trim().split("\\s+");
252
253        // FILTER BY TIME
254        // null = unbound
255        Time[] period = DayPlannerUtils.readTimePeriod(KEYBOARD);
256        Time searchStart = period[0];
257        Time searchEnd = period[1];
258
259        int totalMatches = 0;
260        System.out.println("\nSearch results:");
261
262        for (int position : activities.findTitleMatches(keywords)) {
263            Activity activity = activities.get(position);
264            if (DayPlannerUtils.matchesCriteria(activity, type, searchStart, searchEnd)) {
265                totalMatches++;
266                System.out.println(String.format(
267                    "\t%d. %s",
268                    totalMatches,
269                    activity.toString()
270                ));
271            }
272        }
273
274        // how many activities matched?
275        if (totalMatches == 0)
276            System.out.println("\tNo activities matched your search request.");
277        else
278            System.out.println("\nTotal matched activities: " + totalMatches);
279
280        // press enter to continue
281        KEYBOARD.pressEnterToContinue();
282    }
